source_title: Presidential Decree of the Russian Federation of 16 December 2015 No. 628, on suspension of the Treaty on a Free Trade Area in respect of Ukraine
note: Point 1 suspends, from 1 January 2016, the Treaty on a Free Trade Area signed in St Petersburg on 18 October 2011, in respect of Ukraine, under article 37(4) of Federal Law No. 101-FZ of 15 July 1995. The decree enters into force on the day of signature. Official publication: http://publication.pravo.gov.ru/document/view/0001201512160035. Decree 628 is Russia only. No lapse row is added for KAZ, BLR or ARM.
